An '''Imperial base''' was established on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Revyia]] shortly after the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]] [[Skirmish on Revyia|destroyed]] a [[Revyia smuggler base|smuggler base]] within Revyia's forests. Just outside the base was located [[Revyia Station]], the planet's sole [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]].
